notes:
User is organizing a cluttered shoe closet and plans to sort shoes by type first, then color within each group. They will store out-of-season shoes in bins to free up rack space. A hybrid approach of frequency/occasion may also help keep daily footwear accessible, but type then color is their preferred system.

Shoes owned or being considered:
- New black Converse Chuck Taylor All Stars, now worn six times. User considers them very comfortable and versatile with both jeans and dresses and wants to keep them clean with regular, gentle care. They are considering waterproofing spray for mud and rain; advice should emphasize choosing a product appropriate for the exact upper material (canvas, suede, or leather), testing in a discreet area, following instructions, and checking breathability/color-change concerns. Avoid spraying rubber parts unnecessarily and air-dry away from direct heat.
- Brown leather boots with a loose heel that may detach. User plans to find a cobbler through online searches, reviews, friends/family, local shoe stores, and directories. They should look for experience with leather repair, request a quote and turnaround time, and ask about guarantees. User plans to buy a boot-sized cedar shoe tree and a leather-specific cleaning kit, likely considering brands such as Saphir, Kiwi, or Lexol. Leather care should account for the boot’s finish: use a mild cleaner, soft cloth/brush, appropriate conditioner sparingly, and waterproofer compatible with the leather; test first. Continue avoiding heat and harsh chemicals, and use the tree only when boots are dry and not overly tight.
- White Adidas Superstars, recently worn to the gym and now dirty/scuffed. User cleaned them for about 20 minutes with soap and a toothbrush and was unsure whether that was best. Future cleaning should be gentler: remove loose dirt, use a soft brush/cloth with diluted mild soap, carefully clean rubber soles, wipe away residue, and air-dry away from direct heat or sunlight.
- User is considering buying new Vans Old Skool sneakers and values practical opinions on comfort, durability, style, fit, and value. Advice should note that comfort and durability vary by foot shape and version/material, recommend trying them on, checking the fit, and choosing an upper/material suited to their cleaning and weather needs.

User generally values practical, straightforward advice for shoe organization, shopping, cleaning, repair, and preventive maintenance.
